metadata.case_name: LIU HUNG FAI v. SANDVIK HONGKONG LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Taught Tai Chi sword and handicraft (to earn an income)
plaintiff.occupation_after: Has not been able to teach Tai Chi sword and handicraft since the accident

injuries.description: She was admitted to Kwong Wah Hospital and underwent operations on her left knee.
source: She was admitted to Kwong Wah Hospital and underwent operations on her left knee.
She still suffers pain in her left knee and wasting of muscle.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at lower leg level

manifestations.description: still suffers pain in her left knee
walks with a limp, and a stick when she goes out
cannot squat down and cannot climb up to a height

treatments_received: Underwent operations on her left knee
Transferred to Wong Tai Sin Infirmary for convalescence for 5 months
Physiotherapy treatment on a regular basis
treatments_future: Cost of Joint replacement operation No award
Domestic helper for three hours a day (award calculation: ($60 x 3 x 30) x 12 x 6 = $388,800)

losses.description: Since the time of the accident, she has not been able to teach Tai Chi sword and handicraft which she used to do to earn an income for her living.
Walks with a limp, and a stick when she goes out; cannot squat down and cannot climb up to a height.
Able to manage most affairs but requires some help because of her injuries and age; domestic helper for three hours a day allowed.

comparable_cases.case_name: Leung On & KMB v Chan Pui Ki
